recipes.name: Beef and vegetable rice bowl, bibimbap style
recipes.method_note: Everything sits in its own pile on the rice. You mix it at the table.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} following the packet.
Grate {{ing:carrot-medium}}. Crush {{ing:garlic-clove}}.
Put a frying pan on a high heat. Add {{ing:beef-mince-5-fat}}.
Fry for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until browned all over.
Add the garlic, {{ing:soy-sauce}} and {{ing:sesame-oil}}. Cook 1 minute. Tip into a bowl.
Put {{ing:spinach}} in the same pan. Stir 1 minute, until wilted. Set aside.
Fry {{ing:beansprouts}} for 2 minutes, until hot but still crunchy.
Add {{ing:vegetable-oil}} to the pan. Fry {{ing:egg-medium}} for 3 minutes, until the whites set.
Share the rice between four bowls. Arrange beef, vegetables and carrot on top.
Top each with an egg and some of {{ing:gochujang}}.
steps.note: Gochujang is a chilli paste. Start with a little.

swaps.text: Green or brown lentils (a 400 g tin for every 250 g) or plant-based mince, for a vegetarian version
Tamari, to make it gluten free
Kale or chard; give them 2 minutes longer

recipes.name: Kimchi fried rice
recipes.method_note: Day-old cooked rice fries best. Fresh rice goes sticky. Most kimchi has fish in it; vegan kimchi makes this vegetarian.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} following the packet. Cool it, ideally overnight in the fridge.
steps.note: Already have cooked rice? Use about 400 g.

steps.instruction: Chop {{ing:kimchi}}. Slice {{ing:spring-onion}}.
Put a large frying pan on a high heat. Add {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Fry the kimchi for 2 minutes, until sizzling.
Add the rice. Fry for 5 minutes, stirring, until hot all through.
Stir in {{ing:soy-sauce}}, {{ing:sesame-oil}} and most of the spring onion.
Fry {{ing:egg-medium}} in a second pan for 3 minutes, until the whites set.
Serve the rice topped with an egg and the last spring onion.

recipes.name: Sticky chilli tofu with rice
recipes.method_note: Pressing the tofu helps it crisp. Wrap it in kitchen roll under a heavy pan for 10 minutes.

steps.instruction: Cook {{ing:rice-basmati-dry}} following the packet.
Cut {{ing:tofu-firm}} into bite-sized cubes. Toss in {{ing:cornflour}}.
Put a frying pan on a medium-high heat with {{ing:vegetable-oil}}.
Fry the tofu for 10 minutes, turning, until golden on all sides.
Mix {{ing:gochujang}}, {{ing:soy-sauce}} and {{ing:maple-syrup}} with 2 tablespoons of water.
Crush {{ing:garlic-clove}} into the pan. Add the sauce.
Stir for 2 minutes, until the tofu is sticky and coated.
Cut {{ing:broccoli-head}} into florets. Boil for 4 minutes, until tender.
Serve on the rice with the broccoli. Scatter {{ing:sesame-seeds}} over.
